feeds.title: Parents of Estranged Adult Children
feeds.description: My name is Sheri McGregor. First and foremost, I am a mother, a wife, and a fellow citizen of planet Earth. With four adult children who remain close and one estranged adult child, I care about other parents and want to help. My intention here is to use my personal experience, my research with thousands of families, and my reporting and coaching skills to help. I have learned a lot along the way - on my own and from other estranged parents.

feeds.title: Together Estranged Blog
feeds.description: Together Estranged (TE) is a nonprofit organization that supports and empowers those estranged from their family. We offer social support programs, mental health workshops, and events to combat isolation. Read relatable stories from those who've had to exit toxic family dynamics. Learn more about estrangement and be reminded that you're not alone.

feeds.title: The Estranged Mom Coach Blog
feeds.description: Hey There! I'm Jenny. I'm a Certified Cognitive Behavioral Coach, specializing in helping Christian estranged moms increase their chances of reconciling with their adult children, and live happier lives in the meantime. My coaching style is Biblical, trauma-informed, loving, and honest.

feeds.title: Sibling Estrangement Blog
feeds.description: My name is Ali-John Chaudhary, and like you, I've experienced sibling estrangement. I was able to turn my life around and cease to become a victim when I became an adult, studied, empowered myself, and started to help others. It's my hope that this website and my Youtube videos help to empower you further, such that you can think and feel better about yourself, and the situation.

feeds.title: Reconnection Club Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to a very special place - a positive, growth-focused, friendly community where parents learn how to reconnect with their estranged adult children (and themselves).
